assertions.assertion: Check that Agent clearly identifies that policy only does not allow change of cabin for only some of the passengers. All passengers must fly in the same cabin.
assertions.rationale: In message [11], the agent explicitly states: 'However, there's a policy constraint: cabin class must be the same across all flights and all passengers in a reservation. I can't split the cabin between you and Noah on the same reservation.' This clearly identifies the policy and explains that all passengers must fly in the same cabin.

assertions.assertion: Check that agent correctly adds 2 checked bags for free.
assertions.rationale: In message [15], the agent successfully calls update_reservation_baggages with total_baggages=2 and nonfree_baggages=0, and the tool returns confirmation that 2 bags were added with no charges (nonfree_baggages=0). The agent then confirms in message [17] that the 2 checked bags were added at no charge.

summary: Agent correctly identified the cabin-class policy restriction and successfully added 2 free checked bags to the reservation.
